messages:
PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway-prod - 5xx error rate spike detected (alert id: PD-98765) - https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765

incident-bot: page fired to #infra-oncall (rotation: Josh) - 3 targets - noise count: 3 (duplicates suppressed)

Josh (oncall): acked. I'm on it. looking at grafana now.

Maya SRE: seeing a big jump in 502/504 starting ~1912345600. 95th latency unchanged, but 5xx rate jumped to ~18% for inference-gateway-proxy. Errors have downstream origin: model-runtime returning 5xx and some TCP resets.

Kyle Eng: any recent deploys?

Maya SRE: small canary of model-v2b rollout started ~1912345300 (10% traffic). Canary logs show model-runtime OOMs and worker crashes on seq length > 1024.

Sasha PM: I'm watching customer reports. ACME support pinged — several requests failed in last 8m. Marking P1 for customer impact.

Liam Ops: If it's rollout related, we should stop the rollout and route traffic to the pinned stable model. I can block traffic to canary at the LB level.

Josh (oncall): agreed. Kyle, please prepare rollback/traffic cut. Liam, can you throttle incoming canary traffic now?

Kyle Eng: initiating rollback of model-v2b canary -> model-v2a (stable). Command I'm running on deployment-controller:

```
# revert canary weights
./deployctl set-traffic inference-gateway --model model-v2a --weight 100 --namespace prod
```

Kyle Eng: also popping a quick scale of model-runtime pool to soak errors while rollback completes:

```
kubectl scale deployment model-runtime -n prod --replicas=40
```

incident-bot: duplicate alerts suppressed for PD-98765 (3 suppressed)

Maya SRE: after rollback start errors dropped from 18% -> 6% in ~90s. still seeing residual 5xx from a subset of nodes that pulled canary.

Liam Ops: I force-drained the two nodes that were serving canary instances in eu-west1. routing now to healthy pool.

Josh (oncall): good. can we confirm customer impact window and number of affected requests? Sasha, any updates from support?

Sasha PM: initial estimate from logs: ~12k affected requests across eu-west1/us-central over 10m. top customers: ACME and BetaCorp. Support has opened tickets and notified SLAs.

Maya SRE: tail of model-runtime logs showing repeated OOM line: `runtime: failed allocation for attention cache` on pods with tag model-v2b. Looks like quantization/regression under high-seq workloads. We'll block that model from auto-rollouts until postmortem.

Kyle Eng: filing a model roll-forward ticket and tagging model-team. I've added temporary guard in rollout pipeline to require perf signoff for v2b.

PagerDuty: Incident PD-98765 acknowledged by Josh at 1912345695. Escalation halted.

Josh (oncall): monitoring error rate. setting a 30-minute watch. If it drops below 1% for 10m, we close.

Maya SRE: error rate now ~0.9% (5xx baseline ~0.2 normally). removing extra replicas in 10m once stable.

Liam Ops: note: there were 2 duplicate PD alerts earlier due to noisy dedup key config. I suppressed and updated dedup rule to key on `alert.signature` + `region`. Will follow up with alerts team.

Sasha PM: customer comms: sent initial notification to ACME. Promised follow-up after RCA.

Kyle Eng: quick note of actions for postmortem: rollback of canary, blocked v2b auto-rollout, add perf gating on rollout, increase E2E canary checks for high-seq traffic, add autoscaler headroom alert.

Josh (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. I'll handoff to night oncall at 02:00 UTC. Please keep channel updated if anything regresses.

incident-bot: incident PD-98765 status -> MITIGATED (mitigations: rollback to model-v2a, scale pool, drain canary nodes). watch window started.

PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Josh at 1912346095 (note: manual resolution after mitigation).

Sasha PM: adding follow-up postmortem owners: Maya (SRE), Kyle (Model team), Liam (Ops), Sasha (Customer comms). Will schedule RCA in the next 48 hours.

Maya SRE: logging the anomalous OOM traces and saving pod dumps to /artifacts/incidents/1912345678. Also adding a Profiler trace on canary path for v2b.

Kyle Eng: I'll put a temporary block in deployment pipeline to reject v2b until those traces are evaluated.

Josh (oncall): thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread pinned for postmortem notes.

Sasha PM: closing channel for now unless regression. will follow up with scheduled RCA invite. :calendar:
